fixes: Clear virtual accessibility caches for WebView as well as Compose before reads.
Invalidate the host snapshot after the first-key fallback before typing the remainder.
Use Android input transaction completion before timestamping/injecting paced swipes.
Stop post-tap motion recovery when its missing target is on a different screen context, checking both immediate and delayed navigation.
Only center a scroll target while it is present, including when a pending edge correction survives a snapping animation.
limitations: One Android 16/API 36 emulator. One full pass per pinned runner; no retries.
These are TestBuddy runs against Speedrun fixtures, not new Speedrun-versus-TestBuddy timings.
Upstream Settings fixture expects Display size & text, but installed Android Settings exposes Display size and text. Original fixture retained without edits.
Four Flutter scenario failures also appear in the previously recorded adapter baseline.

The final runner has targeted native animation/lists and Speedrun failure checks after the last two host fixes. The complete 56-case matrix used the earlier candidate; both fingerprints and all failures are retained.

remaining_observations.flutter_a11y_good: Order card is exposed as a single merged semantic node; order_track child ID is absent.
remaining_observations.flutter_navigation: Opening benchflutter://level/3 leaves nav_depth at Depth 0.
remaining_observations.flutter_overlays: Tap on Under during closing veil leaves Under taps at 0.
remaining_observations.flutter_transitions: Tap on amount while closing account list remains interactive selects Credit card; amount receives no text.
remaining_observations.speedrun_settings: Android 16 exact button label is Display size and text instead of upstream Display size & text.
remaining_observations.speedrun_inputs: Two Backspace commands delete two characters, but the app reports Backspaces: 1 instead of 2; reproduced on follow-up.
remaining_observations.speedrun_selectors: Motion recovery replays more-toggle after its successful first action moves it, closing the content again; reproduced on follow-up.
remaining_observations.speedrun_timing: Motion recovery replays lab-tap after its first action moves it, resulting in Taps: 4 instead of 3.
remaining_observations.speedrun_transitions: The closing account list takes the amount-field tap and selects Credit card, leaving no focused field; reproduced on follow-up.
